# Tejas Finserv

> Assistance with Assurance — AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-251896) based in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, India.

Tejas Finserv is an AMFI-accredited mutual fund distribution and financial planning advisory firm founded by Phani Kishore Rompicharla. The firm provides goal-based investment planning, mutual fund distribution across 40+ Asset Management Companies (AMCs) and 6,000+ schemes, pure protection term insurance, comprehensive health insurance, and 15+ free financial calculators.

## About
- [About Us](https://tejasfinserv.com/about): Background on founder Phani Kishore Rompicharla, engineering and advisory credentials, AMFI regulatory accreditation (ARN-251896), and client stewardship philosophy.

## Services
- [Mutual Funds Distribution](https://tejasfinserv.com/mutual-funds): Access 6,000+ mutual fund schemes across 40+ AMCs in India, including Equity, Debt, Hybrid, and ELSS Tax-Saving funds.
- [Goal-Based Financial Planning](https://tejasfinserv.com/financial-planning): Personalized roadmaps for retirement, children's education, home purchase, and wealth preservation.
- [Insurance Advisory](https://tejasfinserv.com/insurance): Life term insurance, family mediclaim/health insurance, and motor insurance advisory.
- [Mutual Fund NAV Today](https://tejasfinserv.com/nav): Latest daily Net Asset Value (NAV) of every open-ended mutual fund scheme in India, updated daily from AMFI.
- [Financial Calculators](https://tejasfinserv.com/calculators): 15+ free financial planning calculators covering SIP, Lumpsum, Retirement, Step-Up SIP, SWP, EMI, and SIP Delay.
